create_pipeline_instance: create a Pipeline instance with a model name, dataset name, and optional config file
run_training_pipeline: run the training and evaluation pipeline by calling the run method on a Pipeline object
configure_pipeline_with_tokenizer: configure a Pipeline with a custom tokenizer, model, dataset, and trainer
get_project_directory: get the tensorboard log directory path from a Pipeline instance using the project_dir property
log_pipeline_message: log a message at a specified level using the Pipeline log method
